risk_summary: The excerpt presents strong, well-quantified 2020 operating and financial performance, including higher revenue, margins, orders, backlog, and improved leverage. Risk disclosure is primarily forward-looking and generic, focusing on market variability, COVID-19 uncertainty, estimates, and competitive conditions without detailed downside scenarios or sensitivity analysis. Overall tone is strongly confident, though housing-cycle, impairment, cost, and accounting-estimate risks remain material.
